items.caveat: No markup - official reseller, in stock, ships ~1-2 days from Canada. Buy the -with-header variant if you want to avoid soldering.
This exact ASIN is an international/US import (~$30). Any A1/A2 UHS-I 32GB card works; cheaper local-brand 32GB cards run ~$10-15. 16GB is enough.

items.ITEM: Waveshare Serial Bus Servo Adapter (Adapter A / BUS servo adapter)
items.store: Amazon.ca (sold by Waveshare, Amazon-fulfilled, in stock)
items.caveat: This is the official 'Adapter A' board that ties the STS3215/FEETECH bus to the Pi over USB/UART. Amazon.ca = ~$17, Prime/free. OE on waveshare.com is ~US$4.99 but ships from China (~$7 + 2-4 wks).
Genuine Adafruit part. Adafruit.com direct is US$34.95 (~C$48)+shipping. Budget clone option: AliExpress ~US$13 (~C$18) but risky (rocky firmware/solder quality, may need rework).

items.ITEM: MAX98357A I2S digital audio amplifier module
items.caveat: Generic clone board - fine for a 3W I2S speaker. 'Small chip' option on same listing is C$7.59.

uxcell 3W 4 ohm micro speaker w/ JST-PH2.0. Amplifier is 4-ohm rated, so 4-ohm driver is the right match.
